title: MR9A breadcrumbs: no GPU (POST d6)
configuration: MACHINIST E5-MR9A PRO V1.2 (Q87), four 16 GB DDR4 DIMMs (64 GB)
observations: No-GPU attempt displayed d6, then a reboot, with no CMOS clear or battery removal.
Recovery boot: RX 550 and 64 GB present, PCI inventory matches, EDAC zero; CMOS again A1, completed BF/00 location 0000, failed count zero.
limits: Consistent with the diagnostic's MRC-only boundary: d6 is a later console-output condition. The snapshot may have been rewritten by the recovery boot. Does not validate failed-pass retention or resolve the missing no-RAM record.
